KaTeX 0.19.1
============

Unmodified browser distribution and fonts from the official `katex@0.19.1`
npm package. The included MIT license applies to these files.

Documentation: https://katex.org/docs/browser.html
Source: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX

Only the introduction page loads this copy. Equations are authored as TeX in
elements marked `data-math` and rendered by `assets/research-math.js` into HTML
and accessible MathML. All scripts, styles and fonts are served locally.
